game_updates.title: Subnautica 2 Early Access 1.2 - Buddy System Update
game_updates.contents: Hello Subnauts, Subnautica 2’s Early Access 1.2 update, Buddy System, just landed! This update introduces the hugely requested Proximity Chat feature, Player Revives, Emotes, Player Trading, two new characters, and a ton of bug fixes. Anything marked with a 🤿 indicates a change that came directly from community feedback! The update should appear as a free, automatic download. If the update doesn’t appear for you, you may need to restart Steam. If you continue to experience issues, please contact our support team here. Want to watch a visual overview of this update? Design Lead Anthony Gallegos talks through some of the changes in our latest Update Vlog. If this is the first post you’ve seen for Subnautica 2 and you're interested in playing, head over to our Steam store page now to check it...

game_updates.contents: Community Update – Discover "The Lair"Outlaws, thieves, and mercenaries with questionable morals will soon have a new place to call home.As part of Wartales’ upcoming free Community Update, we are introducing "The Lair": a new underground location dedicated to those willing to operate outside the law.A Haven for Criminals"The Lair" is accessible from the beginning of your adventure, provided your troop has accumulated enough Suspicion to earn an invitation.Wherever your journey takes you, someone shady will always be nearby, ready to point you toward the closest entrance. game_updates.title: Beta Patch Notes - WS v1.3.0 / BL v1.5.0
game_updates.contents: Greetings Warriors of Calradia, Our last content patch focused on the sandbox simulation. It made diplomacy more responsive and encouraged our lords to pursue meaningful wars, create larger armies, go to sea, harass convoys and raid villages. It also included the new seaborne raid, additional ships and equipment as well as many tweaks to gameplay, visuals and performance. Today’s beta release puts more emphasis on player activities. The segment prior to the patch notes discusses our motivations for some of these changes. War Sails While seafaring offers new opportunities for merchants and warriors alike, it requires substantial progress to not only acquire a ship, but also hire a crew that can fend for themselves. This is sensible from a balance perspective, but gates much of the naval con...

game_updates.title: Full Release 7.27.5 Released! (Experimental)
game_updates.contents: This update is only accessible by switching to our Experimental branches (instructions on how to do so here).Bugfixes:Updated the way the game reads save games so that corrupted (or very old) save games existing in the save game directory can no longer cause crashes.Fixed a mod-related issue with template patching, where the game would crash in some incorrect circumstances when in development mode and template patches were interacting with other modded templates / patches.

game_updates.title: Subnautica 2's latest 1.2 update is friend focused—finally adding the key mechanic to any great multiplayer game
game_updates.contents: I'm not sure there's been a better invention for multiplayer games than proximity chat. Whether it be friends screaming vengeance down the side of a mountain after you abandon them in Peak, or the wails of one of your fellow workers fall suspiciously silent in Lethal Company. Proximity chat offers up fertile ground for hilariously wacky and memorable multiplayer moments, so you can imagine my excitement when I found out it's coming to Subnautica 2... Read more.

game_updates.title: Subnautica 2's new "buddy system" update just made co-op a lot more immersive
game_updates.contents: Subnautica update 1.2 adds co-op revives, player trading, and proximity-based voice chat, enhancing the co-op side of the survival game. Read the full story on PCGamesN: Subnautica 2's new "buddy system" update just made co-op a lot more immersive

game_updates.title: Subnautica 2's Buddy System update brings in the promised proximity chat, easier trading, and emotes so you can sarcastically applaud your friends
game_updates.contents: Another month, another Subnautica 2 update! Last month's focus was on changing creature behaviours to make it a bit less frustrating for those of you that just wanted to go on a killing spree. This month puts the focus on your friends, with the 1.2 update being titled "Buddy System," adding in some neat new features that'll mean you'll have a smoother time playing with your pals. Read more

game_updates.title: Fallout 4 Update - August 18th
game_updates.contents: Added and Updated Features Game Increased the BA2 archive limit from 256 to 1024 to better accommodate larger collections of mods. Added localized strings fixes for UI and platform terminology. Creation Kit Archives are now supported on PlayStation. New file types (.nif, .dds, .bink, .cdx, .csg, .wav, and .fuz (with embedded .wav)) for PlayStation Creations. Bink files can now be added to Creation uploads via an Extra Files browser. Added Localization export support. Creations up to 2 GB in size can now be uploaded for Xbox. Updated "Search and Replace" to align with Starfield, adding buttons for "Select Form in Object Window" and "Open Form Editor."Crashes Game Fixed a crash when the player opens the Virtual Keyboard on a Steam Deck device. Fixed a top crash that would occur due to a stre...

game_updates.title: Update Vlog - Early Access 1.2 (Buddy System)
game_updates.contents: Subnautica 2 Creative Director Anthony Gallegos returns to discuss everything you can expect from the 1.2 update, Buddy System, out tomorrow (August 19th).From features like Proximity Chat, Player Trading and Revives, and an all-new Tracking Tag, there's plenty to see.And there may even be another sneak peek at the upcoming Early Access 2 update...You can continue to speculate and discuss everything about Subnautica 2 in our official Discord server. Join the community and share your thoughts with your fellow Subnauts! You can buy Subnautica 2 on Steam now. And don’t forget to share ideas and upvote things you’d like to see in Subnautica 2 on Nolt.io. Keep Diving!

game_updates.title: Post-summer Studio Update
game_updates.contents: Salvete Romans!We dearly hope your summer has been filled with perfect weather and lots of adventures! The team at Beartwigs have been working hard on bringing you the next update, and so today we're making this post to bring you up to speed on what's happening at the office!The Autumn UpdateThe first grand step of our Roadmap releases the 31st of August!The Autumn Update is rapidly approaching with a whole cart-load of QoL changes and content. Here's what you can expect, on top of a whole heap of bug fixes:Steam Input:Controllers are finally coming to Romestead!We've spent a large chunk of the summer preparing the setup of controllers for Romestead, and we're almost ready to put it back into your hands!Goodbye "Furniture Mode":With the next update we are removing the "Press R to toggle Fu...

game_updates.contents: Bethesda Game Studios is warning owners of Fallout 4 to either log into a save or manually save their mod load order, because a new patch "focusing on general Creations improvements" is incoming... Read more.

game_updates.title: v4.10.03 Hotpatch: PC FPS Drop Update (PC ONLY)
game_updates.contents: Hello again Geese (and Ducks)!Following up on our recent post regarding stuttering and FPS drops affecting some Windows PC players, we've just released a new hotpatch aimed at addressing the issue.Please update to v4.10.03! What's changed?As we shared in our previous update, our investigation pointed to a recent change in mouse pointer handling that could cause significant frame drops on some PCs whenever the mouse was moving.While the underlying behavior appears to originate outside of the game, we've made changes on our end to reduce its impact.We believe this hotpatch should resolve, or significantly reduce, the stuttering and FPS drops for affected players.A huge thank you again to everyone who sent us logs, tested different configurations, and helped us track this down. Your reports g...

game_updates.title: I'm not saying Bethesda are trolling me specifically, but Fallout 4 and Skyrim updates are imminent just as I've modded up the latter for the first time in ages
game_updates.contents: Right, just a couple more location overhauls and there we go. A fresh Skyrim load order created for my first modded toe-dip into Tamriel for quite a while, outside of grabbing the odd article image. Phew, now to relax and sink another 50 hou-wait. Fallout 4 and Skyrim updates are inbound, say Bethesda? Well, that would be my luck, wouldn't it? Read more

game_updates.title: Patch notes 2026-08-17 (experimental)
game_updates.contents: Hello, everyone!Today, we've got a few tweaks to the recently-tweaked Compact Water Pump, and some other helpful changes.Compact Water PumpThe Compact Water Pump is back to being 3x1, but with a slightly updated model. The 2x1 model was too compact and caused water instabilities.Changed the Compact Water Pump's specification, so Platforms and Overhangs can be placed above the intake.Bug fixesFixed a crash that occurred when you obstructed the Compact Water Pump's intake while it was working. Couldn't you have placed it correctly in the first place?Put an end to the bots' existential crisis that left them going back and forth between employed and unemployed.In the map editor, the Natural Overhang no longer uses the "uncovered" model.

game_updates.title: Slay the Spire 2 updates are slowing down again, but don't fear, it's all in the name of more modes, an alternate Act 2, and a character with a bandaged foot
game_updates.contents: Slay the Spire 2 has been moving at a solid pace since it launched into early access back in March, but back in May developer Mega Crit shared that updates would be switching to once every two weeks as opposed to the previously promised weekly updates. Now, as outlined in the game's August Neowsletter, Mega Crit say they'll be slowing down once again, though not necessarily forever. Read more
